main_text.head: EX SECVNDO SAMVELIS libro à versu decimo octauo capitis septimi vsque ad finem.
ARGVMENTVM.
main_text.p: VT data Iessaidi sæper māsura Nathanus Vates promisit regna iubente Deo: Atque per innumeros illius missa nepotes Imperijs cunctis hæc potiora fore. Attonitus tanta Superum bonitate Davides Talia concinuit pectine vota sacro.

Sic ergo me: quem splendida non domus, Claraque[?] auita gentis imagines, Tot ante seruatum periclis Perpetuo decoras fauore? Sic me sereno lumine respicis, Æterne sedis Rector Olympicæ, Ut ferre venturis nepotes Sceptra meos velis usque sæclis? Quæ tanta semper me bonitas tua Non finiendis auget honoribus? Qua vile solari benignus

page.notes: Faint show-through of the other side is visible at the top ("Carmina") and in the right half; it is not printed text on this page and was left out. "Iessaidi": the first letter is a J-like form, read as I; doubtful. "Claraque": the word is hard to read in the scan; the reading is doubtful. "sæclis": the last letters are doubtful. "Qua" in the last line is underlined in print; the underline is left out.
